name: ProbabilityTheory.IsGaussianProcess.iIndepFun_of_covariance_eq_zero
type: {T Ω : Type*} → [MeasurableSpace Ω] → {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} → {S : T → Type*} → {X : (t : T) → S t → Ω → ℝ} → ProbabilityTheory.IsGaussianProcess (fun (p : (t : T) × S t) ω ↦ X p.1 p.2 ω) P → (∀ t s, AEMeasurable (X t s) P) → (∀ t₁ t₂, t₁ ≠ t₂ → ∀ (s₁ : S t₁) (s₂ : S t₂), ProbabilityTheory.covariance (X t₁ s₁) (X t₂ s₂) P = 0) → ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun (fun t ω s ↦ X t s ω) P
provides: A jointly Gaussian family of real processes is mutually independent when every pair of coordinates from distinct processes has zero covariance.
